angle: Rise plus a paid-training and guaranteed-hours offer
title: Raise care pay, train on paid time, offer secure hours
answer: From April 2027, Wexmoor’s care director owns a contractual £1 hourly rise for every contracted carer, including part-time and zero-hours staff. The dedicated fund pays £1.9m annually. Within the remaining £500,000, firms offer paid training and voluntary guaranteed hours matching existing working patterns; checking and cover come first. Total spending stays below £2.4m annually, with no cuts to purchased care hours or other care budgets. Council payroll auditors check monthly payslips against hours worked and require missing pay repaid. Publish payment coverage, missed visits and staff departures quarterly. Fold the rise into the 2028 national deal without reducing hourly pay. Review training and retention after twelve months; extra funding ends March 2029 unless renewed.
